column1: material|/blog/material-participation-str/|material participation,100 hour,100-hour,500 hour,750-hour,participation log|What should an owner document alongside material participation videos?|Use these clips to prepare questions for your tax adviser. Keep dates, tasks, time spent and who performed the work. Separate owner activity from contractor activity and identify the exact test your adviser is evaluating. A video headline cannot determine whether your individual facts qualify.

spouse|/blog/spouse-material-participation/|spouse,wife,husband,married,couple|How should spouses use these STR planning videos?|Discuss the household work plan before the purchase. Record each person's actual tasks, time and operating responsibilities. Compare the plan with employment and family commitments, then ask your tax adviser to evaluate the applicable treatment.

bonus|/blog/bonus-depreciation-str-2026/|bonus depreciation,100% bonus,100% depreciation,depreciation is back|What should you verify after watching a depreciation video?|Confirm the recording date, acquisition and placed-in-service dates, property components and your individual eligibility with your filing professional. Older clips may describe earlier law or assumptions. A large depreciation figure is not the same as an equal cash refund.

tax|/blog/str-tax-video-questions/|tax,taxes,irs,write-off,write off,w2,w-2,loophole,deduction,wealthy|What questions should an STR buyer ask after a tax video?|Ask which assumptions are property-level and which depend on your household return. Separate purchase funding, a potential deduction and an eventual reduction in tax. Have your own adviser review the full facts before using a headline figure in your acquisition budget.

seller|/blog/buy-str-with-seller-financing/|seller financ,seller carry,carryback,seller second|What needs to be written into a seller-financed STR proposal?|Request the price, amount financed, interest, amortization, maturity, balloon balance, security and default provisions. Compare the full payment path with conventional financing and obtain professional review before assuming seller financing lowers total risk.

subject|/blog/subject-to-str-video-questions/|subject to,subject-to,creative financ,ucc|What should you check before following a creative financing example?|Identify the existing debt, who remains liable, lender restrictions, title and insurance arrangements, payment servicing and remedies if payments stop. Ask qualified local professionals to review the actual documents. A lower initial cash requirement does not resolve these obligations.

loan|/blog/str-financing-video-questions/|mortgage,loan,dscr,down payment,10% down,interest rate,bank,financ|How do you turn a financing clip into a comparable loan quote?|Compare the same property, use, borrower, loan size and closing date. Record rate, points, amortization, term, required reserves, prepayment provisions and cash to close. Confirm intended rental use with the lender instead of assuming a loan example fits your application.

market|/blog/how-to-choose-str-market/|market,competition,california,florida,tennessee,smokies,poconos,arizona,colorado,destin,gatlinburg,sevierville,nashville|What should be checked before choosing a market from a video?|Use the recording as a starting point. Refresh local comparable listings, monthly demand, legal-use rules, insurance costs and financing. A market-wide story does not establish the performance or permit eligibility of an individual address.

design|/blog/airbnb-amenities-that-increase-revenue/|amenit,design,furnish,upgrade,hot tub,pool,game room,renovat,bedroom,luxury|How should a buyer budget the upgrades shown in these clips?|Match each improvement with a written scope, installed cost, operating expense and expected guest use. Compare similar competing properties and test a case with no revenue lift. Include installation time and carrying costs before assuming an upgrade pays for itself.

manager|/blog/str-management-video-questions/|manager,management,cohost,co-host,cleaner,cleaning,guest,host,operat,passive,hands-off,hands off|What should you ask a manager after watching these operating videos?|Confirm the fee base, guest coverage, cleaning oversight, maintenance authority, owner access to records and exit terms. Assign responsibility for emergencies and launch tasks. A management introduction is different from a signed agreement with a funded operating plan.

underwriting|/blog/str-underwriting-video-questions/|underwrit,proforma,pro forma,projection,spreadsheet,numbers,analy,profit,cashflow,cash flow,cash-flow,revenue,income,return,roi,booking,occupancy|How should you check a cash-flow claim from a video?|Identify whether the figure means gross revenue, operating income or cash after debt service. Reconcile the same reporting period with expenses, debt, reserves and actual invested cash. Stress-test a weaker season before relying on the example to set an offer price.

risk|/blog/str-risk-video-questions/|risk,lose,losing,loss,bust,fear,scared,crash,recession,mistake,destroy,avoid|How can an STR buyer turn a warning video into a downside plan?|Name the event, estimate the cash effect and decide what evidence could change the purchase decision. Model a slow launch, weaker demand, a major repair and a restriction on rental use. Keep reserves available independently of projected tax savings.

portfolio|/blog/str-portfolio-video-questions/|portfolio,scale,scaling,million,wealth,retire,retirement,10 homes,second property,repeat,stack,10 years|What should be checked before copying a portfolio growth example?|Review the cash and operating capacity needed for the next property as well as the existing portfolio. Separate appreciation, loan paydown, cash distributions and tax effects. A repeat purchase should pass its own underwriting and liquidity review.

first|/blog/how-to-buy-first-airbnb/|first,start,beginner,100k,100,000,buy,buying,real estate,invest,property|How should a first-time buyer use these videos?|Start with available cash, retained reserves, financing, target markets and the work you want help completing. Review a real property file with current quotes and written diligence. Watching a process video does not replace address-specific verification.

company|/blog/bnb-accelerator-service-video-faq/|accelerator,reverse offset,our client,explainer,program,webinar,q&a,group call|What does a BNB Accelerator explainer establish?|It explains the company's published approach. Confirm the current service fee, deliverables, responsible parties, exclusions and termination provisions in your own agreement. Marketing examples and older recordings do not expand the contracted scope.
